name: speko
description: AI phone calls and an AI receptionist on your own number. Call any business or person in the US or abroad, from anywhere, from a number that is yours, so they see it and can call back; every call comes back with a transcript, recording, summary and cost. Set up a receptionist that answers your business line, takes messages and booking requests, and sends you a summary after every call. Also transcribes audio and narrates text. Sign in with OAuth, no API key to paste.
